calls.statement:
SELECT cp.category AS cur_cat, cp.subcategory AS cur_sub, p.subcategory AS was_sub,
       sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units,
       min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1, min(f.quantity) AS minq, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 107
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND (cp.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products' OR p.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products')
GROUP BY ALL

calls.statement:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.category AS cat, p.subcategory AS sub
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
), ctl AS (
  SELECT sum(units_sold) AS ctl_units, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_net, count(*) AS ctl_days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id = 107 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM f WHERE cat <> 'ZZ Test') AS all_units_noZZ,
       (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM f) AS all_units,
       (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM f WHERE cat <> 'ZZ Test') AS all_net_noZZ,
       (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM f) AS dup_rows,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT sale_date) FROM f) AS days_with_sales,
       (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM f WHERE sub = 'Cleaning Products') AS cp_units,
       (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM f WHERE cat = 'Cleaning & Household') AS cat_units,
       (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM f WHERE sub = 'Cleaning Products' AND channel_code = 'WB') AS cp_web_units,
       ctl.ctl_units, ctl.ctl_net, ctl.ctl_days
FROM ctl

SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) AS returned_units, count(*) AS return_lines
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND p.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products'
  AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
